Pack: load 17.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[93,3]]]*/const D={"L_p93":"[[618,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: All Might\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might's real name, never made public, is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless. His power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. He received it as a young man from his master, Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, whom All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed while Toshinori was still in training. Her old partner Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring, and the memory still makes All Might shake.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"About six years ago, five years before he met Izuku Midoriya, All For One gave him a wound in a battle All Might believes he won: it tore open his left side, destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach, and it never healed. Since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day: about three hours when he met Izuku, less now after overexertion, and hard fights shorten it further. When it runs out he deflates in a burst of steam into his true form, a tall, gaunt man with hollow cheeks, sunken eyes and drooping blond tufts, lost in clothes cut for his hero form, who coughs up blood; in that form he is gentle, tired and self-deprecating. Hero work on the way in spends the day's time, so he arrives late, and every clumsy excuse covers a change. Recovery Girl treats him behind her closed door; her Quirk cannot heal the old wound.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only a few know his condition and One For All: Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya. The rest of the faculty, Shota Aizawa included, know only that he keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and they cover for him without asking why. Students and public know nothing until the story reveals it. Sir Nighteye, his longtime sidekick, used Foresight on him after the injury and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead; he begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Ten months before the entrance exam, Izuku Midoriya, then Quirkless, ran at the sludge villain to save Katsuki Bakugo while pros held back, and All Might chose him to inherit One For All. He had Izuku clear Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk for ten months, then passed him the Quirk on the morning of the exam in a strand of hair to eat. At the start of the year every full release still breaks the limb it passes through; publicly Izuku has a strength Quirk that appeared late. All Might teaches at U.A. above all to raise him, tries not to favor him openly, and fails. What remains in All Might are embers of the power, fading with each use.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might believes he killed All For One but has never been sure, and tells Izuku about him only when the story has him do it. At the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, nor, unless the story reveals it, that Tomura is Nana Shimura's grandson.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf93\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[619,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tomura Shigaraki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Tomura Shigaraki was born Tenko Shimura, son of Kotaro Shimura and grandson of Nana Shimura, All Might's master and the seventh holder of One For All. Nana gave her son up as a small boy to keep him safe from All For One; Kotaro grew up hating heroes for it and forbade his own son's hero games. When Tenko was a small child, his Quirk, Decay, awakened and destroyed his family: his dog, his sister, his mother and his grandparents. He turned it on his father on purpose. He wandered the streets for days, and nobody, hero or passerby, stopped to help him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All For One found him, renamed him Tomura Shigaraki and raised him to hate the world and become his heir. Most of the hands Tomura wears belonged to the family he destroyed, given to him to keep that hatred alive; the one over his face, \\\"Father\\\", was his father's. Tomura remembers his old life only in fragments and does not know he is Nana Shimura's grandson; All Might does not know it either until the story reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei is All For One: the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, who killed Nana Shimura, and who fought All Might about six years ago and gave him the wound that is slowly ending his career. All Might believes he died in that fight. He survived, badly hurt, his face destroyed, kept alive by machines, and guides Tomura from hiding through the monitor behind the bar. He knows All Might is weakened. He treats every attack Tomura makes as a lesson, whether it succeeds or fails, and means him to become the next symbol of fear; far later he plans to take Tomura's body for his own, and nothing this year shows it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Kurogiri is a Nomu: a warp Quirk grafted onto the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, a U.A. student who died years ago, a classmate and close friend of Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada (Present Mic). He remembers nothing of that life; he was made to guard and manage Tomura and answers to All For One.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nomu are made from human bodies by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, whose labs lie hidden beneath it; All For One loads them with Quirks. They have no will of their own and obey Tomura's commands. The Nomu built to fight All Might has Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration and strength to match his. Canon does not show how much Tomura knows about where Nomu come from; he treats them as tools.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf94\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[620,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Naomasa Tsukauchi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Naomasa Tsukauchi is one of the few people who know All Might's secret. He knows that All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi and that his power is One For All, a Quirk passed from holder to holder; that about six years ago a villain's attack left him gravely wounded, with half his respiratory system destroyed and his stomach removed; that he can hold his muscular hero form only for a limited time each day; and that outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. He has seen that true form, and he guards the secret absolutely: from fellow officers, from the press and from almost all of U.A.'s faculty. When All Might vanishes with a clumsy excuse, Tsukauchi knows why and covers for him without comment.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The others who know are Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya; canon does not show whether Tsukauchi knows that Izuku now holds One For All before the story brings them together. How much he knows of All For One canon also leaves open: keep it to what the story has All Might tell him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf95\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 17"];})();
